choices.why: The animal's sex as a sign of what is firm in Christ.

pass_a_gloss: it is reasonably counted into a sheep. 'Perfect male yearling' sheep. For Christ is perfect by lacking in nothing and having nothing missing through himself. And male, the firm and manly of him is shown. And yearling it has been said since the year signifies a completed number, the sun being restored upon its own place through twelve months.
pass_b_english: it is reasonably counted toward a sheep. "A perfect male yearling" (Exodus 12:5) sheep. For Christ is perfect in that he lacks nothing and has nothing incomplete through himself. Male makes clear what is firm and manly in him. And it has been called a yearling since the year means a completed number, the sun being restored to its own place through twelve months (Colossians 1:19) (Colossians 2:9).
source_text: συ[να]ριθμε[ῖτ]αι [εἰκότ]ως εἰς πρόβατον. "Τέλ[ει]ον ἄρσ[εν] ἐνιαύσιο[ν]" πρόβατον. Τέλειον γάρ ἐστιν ὁ Χ(ριστὸ)ς τῷ ἐν μηδενὶ ὑστερεῖσθαι μηδὲ ἐλλιπές τι ἔχειν δι’ αὐτοῦ. Ἄρρεν δὲ τὸ στερεὸν καὶ ἀνδρεῖον αὐτοῦ δηλοῦται. Ἐνιαύσιον δὲ εἴρηται ἐπεὶ ὁ ἐνιαυτὸς σημαίνει ἀριθμὸν|| [πεπληρωμένον, ἡλίου ἀποκαθισταμένου ἐπὶ τὸν ἴδιον τόπον διὰ μηνῶν δώδεκα.]
